sources.scope: All-exchange aggregated XRP perpetual liquidation heatmap and spot context.
sources.open_interest_scope: All exchanges aggregated; contract-level venue list and normalization not exposed on this page.
sources.model_scope: Liquidation clusters are modelled from open interest and standard leverage tiers, then cleared after price trades through them.
limitations: Cluster values are estimates, not observed resting orders or guaranteed liquidation levels.
Real liquidation prices depend on position size, margin mode and maintenance margin.
The page does not expose a reconciled contract-by-contract venue universe.

sources.scope: Seven-exchange XRP perpetual summary; 15-minute reporting delay.
limitations: Liquidation feed is a lower bound because exchanges publish only part of real-time liquidations.
Long/short ratio is accounts, not notional exposure.

reconciliation.interpretation: The newer Alpha Finance page increased its OI display from $2.74B at 12:46 UTC to $2.75B at 13:16 UTC. TradRadar's 13:20 UTC page reports $1.89B. The newer snapshots are only four minutes apart, but Alpha describes all exchanges while TradRadar enumerates seven venues; contract universe and normalization are not matched. Preserve both. Do not average.
reconciliation.spot_context: Alpha Finance's 13:16 spot field ($1.1599) and TradRadar's 13:20 mark price ($1.1612) are different instruments/measurement types and are not a synchronized spot-price pair.
reconciliation.liquidation_context: Alpha Finance reports $10.2M long and $454.1K short liquidations. TradRadar reports at least $8.63M total across five venues. The windows/coverage differ; do not add or average.
